title: Saturday jump rope finisher
subtitle: ~10 min · at home · after full body weights
feeling: You just finished a full body weights class. This is a short, fun cardio finisher.
note: Keep it light and bouncy, about 6 out of 10. Small jumps on the balls of your feet. If you trip, just restart, no big deal. Great work today!

items.name: Easy bounce
items.cue: Slow, easy jumps or a gentle bounce in place. Loosen your ankles and shoulders.

sections.label: 2 · Intervals · 8 rounds
sections.instructions: 40 seconds jumping, 20 seconds rest. The timer runs all 8 rounds for you.

items.name: Jump rope
items.cue: Steady rhythm, elbows close to your sides, turn the rope with your wrists. Try alternating feet or a little side to side if you want variety.

items.name: Calf, hamstring and shoulder stretch
items.cue: Stretch each calf against a wall, reach gently toward your toes, and roll your shoulders. Breathe slowly.
